description: NIST's CTC-05, its AP242 edition 1's solid #1205: the same edge as regression/nist-ctc-05-ap203-nurbs-torus-fillet, the B-spline face f109 written as one rational Bézier patch (1 × 1 spans) and the edge's curve as a cubic B-spline of 11 spans (no circle, off the best by 1.6e-3), against the torus f111, filleted alone at the battery's radius. Least principal radius on the ball's side 122 against r 0.889; both ends on the domain boundary with a cylinder across. Arris refuses it Unsupported(NURBS surface × torus surface); Open CASCADE builds a body BRepCheck_Analyzer finds invalid, whose measures are the oracle's (plans/nurbs-face-blend step 1)
